raw.title: [URGENT] Site Solution Engineer
raw.company: CÔNG TY TNHH CÔNG NGHỆ HUAWEI VIỆT NAM
description_list: Spot check on the delivery site quality, subcontractor qualification (check subcontractor training certificate), and EHS.
Perform batch spot check, output quality spot check report, and trigger acceptance.
Perform process KCP self-check at the project level and output the QC checklist.
Adapt the SOP in the project and promote the implementation
Involve in RAN site survey, design for hardware installation (indoor & outdoor installation solution) such as BBU, RRU, antenna, power, grounding installation.
Output site auxiliary material solution such as power cable, optical cable, grounding cable, grounding bar, mechanical antenna bracket
requirements_list: Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunication, Computer Engineering or related field of study
Good knowledge at mobile network site structure, such as indoor site, outdoor site, CRAN site.
Good background of site tower structure such as GMT, self-supported, rooftop towers
Able to use computer assisted drawing software such as AutoCAD, draw site layout, telecom equipment installation layout.
At least 2 years of experience working for major 3G/4G/5G RAN vendors
Candidates who possesses a Tower Climber working safety certificate have a great advantage
Have good background of low voltage electricity knowledge and experience and electricity safety.
Able to communicate effectively in English
Family with Microsoft office, Excel, Power point
Ability to adapt quickly to changing environments and manage parallel time-critical tasks
Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
Hard working & possible to work at weeken
